subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen plugin provider with new provider ids, auth choices, env var, docs, and endpoint metadata?
rationale: The request fits the qwen plugin boundary and model-provider roadmap, but it publishes new user-facing auth/config/provider contracts that repository policy treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept bundled qwen provider
options.body: Review, rebase, and land the linked PR once its generated/catalog surfaces, conflicts, and validation are acceptable.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Ask for Token Plan support to live as an external plugin or ClawHub package if maintainers do not want another official Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide custom provider config is the supported path for this Alibaba plan.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled qwen provider
recommendation.body: Review, rebase, and land the linked PR once its generated/catalog surfaces, conflicts, and validation are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the qwen provider/plugin surface and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for this provider-contract decision.
